title: JuICE: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Judge in Identifying Cultural Errors
reasoning: The JuICE benchmark explicitly evaluates cultural and religious competence. It includes error categories like 'Cultural Missingness' and 'Cultural Specificity' that test for accurate religious representation (e.g., identifying the six officially recognized religions in Indonesia) and religious practices (e.g., the distinction between 'pengajian' and general religious activities), as well as spiritual connotations (e.g., associations with mysticism and spirits).
